stem: A student wants to revise named gastrointestinal diagnoses rather than broad symptom groups; which section title is the best fit?
explanation: Specific GI Conditions is the best section title for revising named gastrointestinal diagnoses. It matches individual GI conditions rather than a single illness, an unrelated topic, or a different body system.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Page 1

optionExplanations.A: Correct because Specific GI Conditions is the section title that best fits revision of named gastrointestinal diagnoses.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because Gastroenteritis is a single condition, not a broad section title covering multiple named GI diagnoses.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because Jaundice in Children relates to a different clinical topic and is not a GI conditions section.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because Spirometry is a respiratory investigation and is unrelated to gastrointestinal revision.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because Sleep in Infancy and Children is unrelated to gastrointestinal diagnoses.
